newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed for Japanese holiday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed for Japanese holiday.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures were not traded on Tuesday due to a holiday in Japan. Trading will resume on Wednesday.
On Monday, the benchmark Nikkei 225 March contract ended 355 points higher at 18,195 after trading in a 500-point range and hitting a high of 18,329. Turnover was 15,355 lots.

Dealers said the Nikkei markets were supported by the dollar's decline against the yen after a weekend Group of Seven meeting signalled a desire for currency stability and noted that misalignments in exchange markets had been corrected.
